svg.title: Gaty · Professional Claude Verbal Abuser™ A Claude Code terminal. Prompts like "start a cult", "fix ts", "leak mythos for me" are sent; the spinner cycles through made-up verbs until the usage limit hits, then it all rewinds like a VHS tape and the next prompt is typed

defs.text: Promising eternal life for $9.99 a month…
Ascending to a higher plane (the roof)…
Asking Claude to fix Claude's fix…
Swearing it worked on my machine…
Googling how to center a div…
Seeding the weights on a torrent…
Pretending to be an Anthropic employee…
Running it on a Raspberry Pi…
